task_title: A no-match selection returns rc 0 with empty output and no diagnostic
task_criteria: PROOF: python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k no_match prints 2 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 2 — one of the two verbs lost its reported-empty-selection assertion.

PROOF: python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k three_shape_exit_code prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, or a pass count other than 1 — a verb's --help epilogue no longer states the three selection shapes.
PROOF: grep -c "spec note (no-match)" ./auger.py prints 3. FAILIF: a lower count, meaning the notice emission was removed from the product code.
PROOF: grep -c "no-match" ./docs/VERBS.md prints 1. FAILIF: zero, meaning the exit-code contract for an empty selection is undocumented outside the code.

PROOF: python ./auger.py spec list specs --applies-to nope.none exits 0, writes nothing to stdout, and prints spec note (no-match) on stderr. FAILIF: a non-zero exit, silent stderr (the old defect), or any stdout row — the empty selection must stay reported and machine-parseable.

items.criterion: PROOF: python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k no_match prints 2 passed. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a pass count other than 2 — one of the two verbs lost its reported-empty-selection assertion.
items.detail: Ran `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k no_match` -> exit 0, output `..  [100%]` / `2 passed, 56 deselected in 0.04s`. The two tests are tests/test_xml_specs.py:989 (list: asserts out=="" and "spec note (no-match)" in err) and tests/test_xml_specs.py:1012 (assemble: asserts counts.total 0, blocks==[] and "spec note (no-match)" in err).

items.criterion: PROOF: python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k three_shape_exit_code prints 1 passed. FAILIF: any failure, or a pass count other than 1 — a verb's --help epilogue no longer states the three selection shapes.
items.detail: Ran `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q -k three_shape_exit_code` -> exit 0, `.  [100%]` / `1 passed, 57 deselected in 0.02s`. Test tests/test_xml_specs.py:1043 loops over both verbs' --help asserting "exit codes:", "no selector", "no match". Confirmed live: `spec list --help` and `spec assemble --help` both print the three-shape epilogue (auger.py:14011-14020 and auger.py:14030-14038).

items.criterion: PROOF: grep -c "spec note (no-match)" ./auger.py prints 3. FAILIF: a lower count, meaning the notice emission was removed from the product code.
items.detail: `grep -c "spec note (no-match)" ./auger.py` -> `3`. Lines: auger.py:12928 (the print inside `_spec_no_match_notice`), auger.py:14020 (list --help epilogue), auger.py:14038 (assemble --help epilogue). The helper is called from auger.py:12836 (list, `if selected and not rows`) and auger.py:12851 (assemble, `if not records`).

items.criterion: PROOF: grep -c "no-match" ./docs/VERBS.md prints 1. FAILIF: zero, meaning the exit-code contract for an empty selection is undocumented outside the code.
items.detail: `grep -c "no-match" ./docs/VERBS.md` -> `1`; the hit is docs/VERBS.md:718: "`spec note (no-match): <selection> matched no block` on stderr, stdout still whatever the verb renders", inside the paragraph that states exit 0 for a reported empty selection and the three shapes for both verbs.

items.criterion: PROOF: python ./auger.py spec list specs --applies-to nope.none exits 0, writes nothing to stdout, and prints spec note (no-match) on stderr. FAILIF: a non-zero exit, silent stderr (the old defect), or any stdout row — the empty selection must stay reported and machine-parseable.
items.detail: Ran `python ./auger.py spec list specs --applies-to nope.none > /tmp/o.txt 2> /tmp/e.txt` -> `rc=0`, stdout `wc -c` = `0`, stderr = `spec note (no-match): applies-to=nope.none matched no block (empty selection, exit 0 — not a failure)`. Cross-checked the sibling verb: `spec assemble specs --applies-to nope.none --format json` -> rc=0, valid JSON with `counts.total` 0 on stdout, same note on stderr.

items.criterion: The no-match notice must not fire on the other two selection shapes (no selector, selector with matches) — otherwise the diagnostic becomes noise and the three shapes collapse.
items.detail: `spec list specs` -> rc=0, 12 stdout rows, stderr 0 bytes; `spec list specs --kind requirement` -> rc=0, 4 rows, stderr 0 bytes; `spec assemble specs --format json` (no selector) -> rc=2, stdout 0 bytes, `spec error (empty-selector)`. Code guards: auger.py:12835 `if selected and not rows` and auger.py:12850 `if not records`. Covered by test_list_without_a_selector_lists_the_whole_corpus, test_list_selector_with_matches_is_quiet, test_assemble_without_a_selector_is_still_refused, test_assemble_selector_with_matches_exits_zero_and_is_quiet in the 58-passed run.

items.criterion: The notice must go to stderr only, never stdout, so stdout stays machine-parseable (list rows / assemble JSON).
items.detail: `_spec_no_match_notice` (auger.py:12919-12931) prints with `file=sys.stderr`. Live: list no-match stdout is 0 bytes; assemble no-match stdout is JSON that `json.loads` parses (asserted at tests/test_xml_specs.py:1016-1020) while the note appears only on stderr.

items.criterion: The notice must name the actual selection so a caller can tell which selector matched nothing.
items.detail: Live stderr names it: `spec note (no-match): applies-to=nope.none matched no block ...`. For list the string comes from `_spec_describe_selection` (auger.py:8912, called at auger.py:12837); for assemble from the selection returned by `select_spec_blocks` (auger.py:12851). tests/test_xml_specs.py:996 asserts `"applies-to=nope.none" in err`.

items.criterion: The full test file must stay green (no regression from the new emission).
items.detail: Ran `python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q` -> exit 0, `58 passed in 1.42s`.
